name: GitHub Bar
description:
Your GitHub notifications, review requests and pull request CI status in the top bar.

It uses the GitHub CLI's login (run gh auth login once): it reads gh's token from the keyring or gh's hosts.yml on each update and never stores it. It talks only to api.github.com and GitHub's avatar server, and caches your avatar under ~/.cache/github-bar@jackicus. The only change it makes on GitHub is marking notifications read.
